name: Paintings after Ancient Masters: A Lohan [after Guanxiu]
material: album leaf, ink and color on silk
summary: The twenty paintings in this double album by Chen Hongshou include landscapes, figures, and flowers. It also has one leaf featuring a woman, an often-used subject not found in the other albums from the latter part of his career.
